db.cmd: docker start -a hm-postgres || docker run --name hm-postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=app -p 54329:5432 postgres:17-alpine

redis.cmd: docker start -a hm-redis || docker run --name hm-redis -p 63799:6379 redis:8-alpine

worker.cmd: timeout 120 bash -c 'until (: </dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/63799) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done' && exec uv run watchmedo auto-restart --directory=. --pattern='*.py' --recursive -- celery -A config worker --loglevel=info

web.cmd: timeout 180 sh -c 'until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 54329 -q; do sleep 1; done' && uv run manage.py migrate --noinput && exec uv run manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:${PORT:-8000}
